market_outlook.short_term: Bearish-to-neutral. 50bps Fed hike likely next week; AI sector correction continues 2-3 weeks; diesel/energy inflation feeds CPI; bond market remains the dominant signal. Expect S&P 500 volatility 12-15% annualized. Barclays 7,950 target achievable but not in next 30 days.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive. Alphabet AI monetization, energy transition (wind records), and China stimulus (if delivered) support 6-12 month recovery. However, 5%+ yield regime and structural inflation from energy constraints cap upside. S&P 500 likely 7,200-7,950 range by year-end.
